description: This file contains JUnit 5 test cases for the DateUtils class, with Mockito mocking, verifying date and week number calculations.

classes.name: DateUtilsTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing DateUtils utility methods, including week number calculations and date range checks.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes Mockito static mock for DateUtils.TimeUtils and sets up default behaviors.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Closes the static mock for DateUtils.TimeUtils.

methods.name: mockFirstWeekOfYear
methods.description: Mocks the current date-time to January 1, 2020, and retrieves the current week number.

methods.name: mockFortiethWeekOfYear
methods.description: Mocks the current date-time to October 1, 2020, and retrieves the current week number.

methods.name: mockLastWeekOfYear
methods.description: Mocks the current date-time to December 25, 2020, and retrieves the current week number.

methods.name: correctlyGetWeekNumberOfYear
methods.description: Test verifying correct retrieval of week numbers for the first, fortieth, and last week of the year.

methods.name: correctlyGetWeeksLeftInYearFromCurrentWeek
methods.description: Test verifying calculation of weeks remaining in the year from various current weeks.

methods.name: correctlyCheckIfDateIsInCurrentYear
methods.description: Test asserting whether dates are correctly identified as within the current year.

methods.name: correctlyCheckIfDateIsInFuture
methods.description: Test asserting whether dates are correctly identified as future dates.
